preset: WFM stereo + RDS (FM broadcast, RDS in a Lua script)
description: FM broadcast in stereo with RDS: the chain of the WFM stereo preset, and the RDS branch: MPX -> analytic -> 57 kHz to 0 Hz -> +-2.4 kHz -> 12 kS/s -> a Script (Lua) that does the rest: carrier phase, biphase bits (12 bit-clock phases at once, the one in block sync wins), differential decoding, block sync by the syndrome with burst correction, and the groups (PI, PTY, PS, RadioText, clock time). Its table shows them; PS and RT also go out as frames to the Text display. The code is in the JSON: "Edit code" opens it.
name: WFM stereo + RDS

params.code:
-- RDS (IEC 62106) decoder. Input (on_iq): the 57 kHz subcarrier moved to 0 Hz and low-passed
-- (+-2.4 kHz), at about 8..20 kS/s. Here:
--  1. carrier phase from the averaged square of the signal (BPSK: z^2 has no data);
--  2. biphase bits, 1187.5 bit/s: + in the first half of a bit, - in the second; the bit
--     clock is tracked by the zero crossing every bit has in its middle;
--  3. differential decoding, 26-bit blocks (16 data + 10 check bits + offset word
--     A / B / C / C' / D), block sync by the syndrome;
--  4. groups: PI, PTY, PS (0A/0B), RadioText (2A/2B), clock time (4A).
-- Shown in the block; PS and RT also go out as frames (emit) for a Text display.

local BITRATE = 1187.5
local OFFSET = {0x0FC, 0x198, 0x168, 0x1B4}   -- A, B, C, D (C' = 0x350 in place of C)
local OFFSET_CP = 0x350

-- remainder of the 26-bit word by g(x) = x^10+x^8+x^7+x^5+x^4+x^3+1: for a right block
-- it equals the block's offset word
local function syndrome(w)
  local reg = 0
  for i = 25, 0, -1 do
    reg = (reg << 1) | ((w >> i) & 1)
    if reg & 0x400 ~= 0 then reg = reg ~ 0x5B9 end
  end
  return reg
end

-- error correction: the syndrome of a single wrong bit or two neighbouring ones (one wrong
-- biphase bit is two after the differential decoding) -> the error. The code could correct
-- longer bursts, but then wrong "corrections" of noise get through.
local FIX = {}
for _, pat in ipairs({1, 3}) do
  for sh = 0, 25 do
    local e = (pat << sh) & 0x3FFFFFF
    if (e >> sh) == pat then local z = syndrome(e); if FIX[z] == nil then FIX[z] = e end end
  end
end

-- EBU Latin-based RDS character set (IEC 62106 Annex E), 0x80..0xFF
local HI = {
  "á","à","é","è","í","ì","ó","ò","ú","ù","Ñ","Ç","Ş","β","¡","Ĳ",
  "â","ä","ê","ë","î","ï","ô","ö","û","ü","ñ","ç","ş","ğ","ı","ĳ",
  "ª","α","©","‰","Ǧ","ě","ň","ő","π","€","£","$","←","↑","→","↓",
  "º","¹","²","³","±","İ","ń","ű","µ","¿","÷","°","¼","½","¾","§",
  "Á","À","É","È","Í","Ì","Ó","Ò","Ú","Ù","Ř","Č","Š","Ž","Đ","Ŀ",
  "Â","Ä","Ê","Ë","Î","Ï","Ô","Ö","Û","Ü","ř","č","š","ž","đ","ŀ",
  "Ã","Å","Æ","Œ","ŷ","Ý","Õ","Ø","Þ","Ŋ","Ŕ","Ć","Ś","Ź","Ŧ","ð",
  "ã","å","æ","œ","ŵ","ý","õ","ø","þ","ŋ","ŕ","ć","ś","ź","ŧ"," "}
local function ch(c)
  if c == 0x0D then return "\r" end           -- the end of a RadioText
  if c >= 0x20 and c < 0x7F then return string.char(c) end
  if c >= 0x80 then return HI[c - 0x7F] end
  return " "
end

local PTY = {"None","News","Current affairs","Information","Sport","Education","Drama","Culture","Science",
  "Varied","Pop music","Rock music","Easy listening","Light classical","Serious classical","Other music",
  "Weather","Finance","Children's","Social affairs","Religion","Phone-in","Travel","Leisure","Jazz music",
  "Country music","National music","Oldies music","Folk music","Documentary","Alarm test","Alarm"}

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- groups
local ps, rt = {}, {}
for i = 1, 8 do ps[i] = " " end
for i = 1, 64 do rt[i] = " " end
local psSeen, rtSeen, rtAB, lastPS, lastRT = 0, 0, -1, "", ""
local groups, blocksOk, blocksBad = 0, 0, 0   -- (counted over the groups used)

local function group(a, b, c, d, cOk, dOk)
  groups = groups + 1
  show("PI", string.format("%04X", a))
  local gt, ver = b >> 12, (b >> 11) & 1
  show("PTY", PTY[((b >> 5) & 31) + 1] .. ((b >> 10) & 1 == 1 and "   (TP)" or ""))
  if gt == 0 and dOk then                       -- 0A / 0B: programme service name, 2 chars a group
    local seg = b & 3
    local a1, a2 = ch(d >> 8), ch(d & 0xFF)
    -- a changed segment: the name is new only when all four came again since
    if ps[seg * 2 + 1] ~= a1 or ps[seg * 2 + 2] ~= a2 then psSeen = 0 end
    ps[seg * 2 + 1], ps[seg * 2 + 2] = a1, a2
    psSeen = psSeen | (1 << seg)
    local s = table.concat(ps)
    show("PS", s)
    if psSeen == 15 and s ~= lastPS then lastPS = s; emit("PS: " .. s); log("PS  " .. s) end
  elseif gt == 2 then                           -- 2A / 2B: RadioText, 4 (2A) or 2 (2B) chars a group
    local ab = (b >> 4) & 1
    if ab ~= rtAB then                          -- A/B flag flipped: a new text
      if rtAB >= 0 then for i = 1, 64 do rt[i] = " " end end
      rtAB, rtSeen = ab, 0
    end
    local seg = b & 15
    rtSeen = rtSeen | (1 << seg)
    if ver == 0 then
      if cOk then rt[seg * 4 + 1] = ch(c >> 8); rt[seg * 4 + 2] = ch(c & 0xFF) end
      if dOk then rt[seg * 4 + 3] = ch(d >> 8); rt[seg * 4 + 4] = ch(d & 0xFF) end
    elseif dOk then
      rt[seg * 2 + 1] = ch(d >> 8); rt[seg * 2 + 2] = ch(d & 0xFF)
    end
    local s = (table.concat(rt):gsub(" +$", ""))
    local cr = s:find("\r", 1, true)
    if cr then s = s:sub(1, cr - 1) end
    show("RT", s)
    -- the whole text is in when every segment up to its end (the CR, or the last one) came
    local last = cr and (cr - 1) // (ver == 0 and 4 or 2) or 15
    local all = (1 << (last + 1)) - 1
    if rtSeen & all == all and #s > 0 and s ~= lastRT then lastRT = s; emit("RT: " .. s); log("RT  " .. s) end
  elseif gt == 4 and ver == 0 and cOk and dOk then   -- 4A: clock time (UTC + local offset)
    local mjd = ((b & 3) << 15) | (c >> 1)
    local hour, min = ((c & 1) << 4) | (d >> 12), (d >> 6) & 63
    local off = (d & 31) * 30 * (((d >> 5) & 1) == 1 and -1 or 1)
    local y = math.floor((mjd - 15078.2) / 365.25)
    local m = math.floor((mjd - 14956.1 - math.floor(y * 365.25)) / 30.6001)
    local day = mjd - 14956 - math.floor(y * 365.25) - math.floor(m * 30.6001)
    local k = (m == 14 or m == 15) and 1 or 0
    local t = (hour * 60 + min + off) % 1440
    show("CT", string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d local", 1900 + y + k, m - 1 - k * 12, day, t // 60, t % 60))
  end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- block sync
-- One decoder per bit-clock phase (PHASES of them, 1/PHASES bit apart). Each finds block sync
-- by itself; the sample clock drifts (tens of ppm), so the best phase changes over time and
-- another decoder takes over. Neighbouring phases give the same group within a bit or two:
-- the candidates of one group are collected and the cleanest (fewest corrected blocks) is used.
local PHASES = 12
local synced, fixed = 0, 0
local pending = nil            -- {at = time in bits, score, blocks...} of the group being collected

local function flush()
  if not pending then return end
  local g = pending
  pending = nil
  for n = 1, 4 do if g.okb[n] then blocksOk = blocksOk + 1 else blocksBad = blocksBad + 1 end; if g.fixb[n] then fixed = fixed + 1 end end
  group(g.blk[1], g.blk[2], g.blk[3], g.blk[4], g.okb[3], g.okb[4])
  show("groups", string.format("%d  (blocks %d ok, %d of them corrected, %d bad)", groups, blocksOk, fixed, blocksBad))
end

local function newDecoder(phase)
  return {pos = phase, h1 = 0, h2 = 0, prevBit = 0,
          reg = 0, nbits = 0, sync = false, lastPos = -1, lastK = -1, k = 0, cnt = 0, blk = {}, okb = {}, fixb = {}, bad = 0}
end

local function bit(D, b, now)
  D.nbits = D.nbits + 1
  D.reg = ((D.reg << 1) | b) & 0x3FFFFFF
  if not D.sync then
    local s = syndrome(D.reg)
    local f = nil
    for i = 1, 4 do if s == OFFSET[i] then f = i - 1 end end
    if s == OFFSET_CP then f = 2 end
    if f then
      -- two blocks 26 x m bits apart, in the right order: in sync
      local dist = D.nbits - D.lastPos
      if D.lastPos >= 0 and dist % 26 == 0 and dist <= 26 * 4 and (D.lastK + dist // 26) % 4 == f then
        D.sync, D.k, D.cnt, D.bad, D.blk, D.okb, D.fixb = true, (f + 1) % 4, 0, 0, {}, {}, {}
        if f == 0 then D.blk[1], D.okb[1] = D.reg >> 10, true end
        synced = synced + 1
      end
      D.lastPos, D.lastK = D.nbits, f
    end
    return
  end
  D.cnt = D.cnt + 1
  if D.cnt < 26 then return end
  D.cnt = 0
  local s = syndrome(D.reg)
  local word = D.reg
  local ok = s == OFFSET[D.k + 1] or (D.k == 2 and s == OFFSET_CP)
  if not ok then
    -- a burst error? syndrome(word) = offset xor syndrome(error)
    local e = FIX[s ~ OFFSET[D.k + 1]] or (D.k == 2 and FIX[s ~ OFFSET_CP]) or nil
    if e then word = word ~ e; ok = true; D.fixb[D.k + 1] = true end
  end
  D.blk[D.k + 1], D.okb[D.k + 1] = word >> 10, ok
  D.bad = ok and math.max(0, D.bad - 1) or D.bad + 1
  if D.k == 3 then
    -- a candidate of a group (blocks A and B right): the best of the phases is kept
    if D.okb[1] and D.okb[2] then
      local score = 0
      for n = 1, 4 do score = score + (D.okb[n] and 10 or 0) - (D.fixb[n] and 3 or 0) end
      if pending and now - pending.at > 52 then flush() end
      if not pending or score > pending.score then
        pending = {at = pending and pending.at or now, score = score, blk = D.blk, okb = D.okb, fixb = D.fixb}
      end
    end
    D.blk, D.okb, D.fixb = {}, {}, {}
  end
  D.k = (D.k + 1) % 4
  if D.bad > 6 then D.sync, D.lastPos = false, -1; synced = synced - 1 end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- demodulator
local ar, ai = 0, 0            -- averaged z^2: the carrier phase (BPSK, so z^2 has no data)
local step = nil               -- bits per sample
local bits = 0                 -- time in bits (for telling groups apart)
local dec = {}
for p = 1, PHASES do dec[p] = newDecoder((p - 1) / PHASES) end

function on_iq(i, q)
  step = step or BITRATE / rate(1)
  ar = 0.995 * ar + (i * i - q * q)
  ai = 0.995 * ai + 2 * i * q
  local th = math.atan(ai, ar) / 2
  local v = i * math.cos(th) + q * math.sin(th)
  bits = bits + step
  if pending and bits - pending.at > 52 then flush() end   -- every phase had its say
  for p = 1, PHASES do
    local D = dec[p]
    -- biphase: + in the first half of a bit, - in the second
    if D.pos < 0.5 then D.h1 = D.h1 + v else D.h2 = D.h2 + v end
    D.pos = D.pos + step
    if D.pos >= 1 then
      D.pos = D.pos - 1
      local b = D.h1 > D.h2 and 1 or 0
      bit(D, b ~ D.prevBit, bits)  -- differential decoding
      D.prevBit = b
      D.h1, D.h2 = 0, 0
    end
  end
end
